projects.title: Radar Pose Estimation
description: Researched and implemented mmWave radar point cloud to human skeleton prediction for posture recognition.
Built a data processing pipeline generating a ~150K-sample dataset from raw radar recordings.
Trained a TensorFlow/Keras model predicting human skeletal joints from radar point cloud data.
Generated 3D human mesh and skeleton labels with ExPose for supervised model training.
Streamed live radar data over MQTT to visualise real-time skeletal motion from point clouds.

projects.title: Conversational Voice AI
description: Built a service bridging live telephony call audio with a conversational AI provider over WebSockets.
Designed a concurrency-capped FIFO dispatch queue with request dedupe and in-place replacement.
Handled missed-call callbacks and working-hours-aware retry scheduling across timezones.
Mapped per-programme agent configuration and conversation variables from CRM lead fields.
Automated meeting scheduling through Google Meet and Calendar APIs.

projects.title: Serverless Workflow Migration
description: Migrated 30+ business workflows from a no-code database to PostgreSQL.
Rebuilt them on an event-driven AWS serverless architecture using Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and SES.
Implemented SQS-based message queuing and SES for automated email notifications.
Used EventBridge for time-based automation and orchestration of workflows.
Developed the Node.js backend managing APIs, data pipelines, and automation logic.

projects.title: Real-Time Chat & Calling App
description: Built cross-platform Flutter apps published to both the Play Store and the App Store.
Implemented real-time messaging over Socket.IO and Matrix SDK with media, receipts, and roles.
Integrated native Twilio audio and video calling for Android and iOS with stable call performance.
Integrated 100+ backend APIs covering chat, user management, and application features.
Added offline-first Realm and Hive storage with local sync, plus Firebase push notifications.

projects.title: Document Verification & ERP Sync
description: Owned a document-verification feature end to end across the data, business, and API layers.
Built two-way sync with a freight ERP, using version watermarking to avoid re-sending documents.
Implemented inbound webhooks for verification verdicts and operations-uploaded documents.
Enforced a state machine guarding document removal, approval, and entity-type transitions.
Hardened the flow with atomic transactions, scoped lookups, streamed uploads, and named error codes.

projects.title: Bulk Lead Importer
description: Replaced ORM-based import with direct transactional SQL, cutting multi-hour imports to seconds.
Added Postgres-native deduplication on phone and email at insert time.
Designed a two-phase flow that pre-resolves every relation before writing, aborting cleanly on mismatch.
Wrapped each row in a SAVEPOINT so a single bad row cannot fail the whole batch.
Supported dry-run imports with full rollback and grouped error reporting.

projects.title: Ad-Platform Event Sync
description: Converted CRM lead stage changes into ad-platform conversion events, never sent inline.
Built a durable queue and background worker batching up to 1000 events per request.
Hashed personal data with SHA-256 before transmission.
Implemented exponential-backoff retry with dead-lettering and manual replay.
Made delivery restart-safe: queued before send and deduped by lead and stage.

projects.title: Telephony CDR Sync
description: Synced call detail records from a cloud telephony provider into CRM, replacing manual scripts.
Built watermark-based incremental fetch that automatically catches up after downtime.
Implemented a global throttle honouring a two-calls-per-minute upstream rate limit.
Made the sync idempotent by call UID and crash-safe with no unnecessary data retention.
Anchored the interval scheduler to the wall clock so missed runs coalesce instead of being skipped.

projects.title: Email Subscription & Notifications
description: Built subscription preference APIs for both public and internal consumers.
Enforced email preferences at queue time rather than at send time.
Added unsubscribe footers with RFC 8058 one-click headers.
Audit-logged preference changes together with the effective previous state.
Rendered air waybill numbers on shipment status emails via a snapshot column.

projects.title: CRM Platform Modules
description: Built 10+ modules covering lead capture, routing, deduplication, and admissions reporting.
Implemented click-to-call that intercepts the native call flow with no duplicate UI.
Added SQL-view-backed dashboards for admissions and agent productivity.
Built strict round-robin and automatic reassignment engines for fair lead distribution.
Integrated ad-platform lead ads and WhatsApp templates as first-class lead sources.

projects.title: Field Survey Mobile App
description: Built an offline-capable Flutter app for field household surveys and enrolment.
Shipped through a DEV/QA/production release flow across 60+ tagged versions.
Implemented draft saving, validation, and conditional multi-step form flows.
Integrated REST APIs for survey and household data synchronisation.

projects.title: Social Platform App & Backend
description: Built a Flutter social app published to both the Play Store and the App Store.
Implemented authentication with OTP verification and role-based registration.
Migrated backend file storage from AWS S3 to Azure Blob with a compression pipeline.
Added real-time WebSocket events and a notification polling service.
Built transactional account deletion with safety guards, plus Razorpay payments.

projects.title: Drone Feed Analysis
description: Created a Flutter desktop app for drone video analysis tasks.
Used OpenCV and MTCNN for object detection and tracking.
Stored real-time event data using MySQL relational schema.
Enabled fast filtering and query using Elastic Search tool.
Built custom UI/UX for navigating drone-based detection.

projects.title: Perimeter Security System
description: Built a desktop app with face and object recognition in Flutter.
Used YOLOv8 and FaceNet for high-accuracy surveillance.
Managed user data and logs in a MySQL relational database.
Enabled real-time alerts and access control via detection.
Designed interfaces for administrators to view live feed.

projects.title: Corporate Marketing Website
description: Developed responsive website UI using React and Tailwind CSS.
Added dynamic animations with GSAP and Framer Motion APIs.
Implemented backend using Express and Node.js services.
Managed contact forms and CMS data using MySQL backend.
Optimized web performance and SEO using modern practices.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
education.institution: Sagar Institute of Science and Technology, Bhopal
education.description: Graduated with a CGPA of 8.5, specialising in software engineering, data structures, and algorithms. Built full-stack web and machine learning projects through the degree, and started working professionally as a developer before graduating.
Completed with a focus on Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. Participated in various science fairs and competitions.
Graduated with a focus on Science and Mathematics. Actively participated in extracurricular activities and sports.
